_warning: WRITE SCOPE — this server process can mutate the knowledge base (add/update/delete/link items, flag issues, review decisions). The write scope only starts when SECONDBRAIN_WRITE_TOKEN is set to a non-empty secret: the token gates the write server, and without it the process exits 1 before the transport connects. Replace the placeholder below with a long random token from your env/secret manager (never committed to git), and only attach this server to TRUSTED agents. For untrusted/coding agents use the read-scope server instead (see claude_desktop.config.json / claude_code.mcp.json).
